# dsh-tv
**English** | 中文
> **Mirror:** if `github.com` web pages are slow or blocked (504) in your network, read this README
via jsDelivr: <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/MathewWuZJ/dsh-tv@main/README.md>. Git-based installs are
: <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/MathewWuZJ/dsh-tv@main/README.md>. Git-based installs are unaffected.
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that opens a **short-video / TV panel in the right sidebar**, so you
can watch something while an agent works. On Desktop it embeds a real Electron `<webview>` (real br
owser engine), not an iframe.
> Not affiliated with DeepSeek, Douyin, YouTube, Bilibili, Instagram or any listed site. Site names
and icons belong to their owners.
## Features
- **One entry, top-right**: a `DSH-TV` icon button in the conversation header opens / collapses the

panel.
- **Tab bar with real favicons** (no text labels): Douyin, Short-drama, YouTube, Bilibili, In

stagram, HackerTube, plus **Global TV** pinned first.
- **Global TV (random)**: a self-hosted player
picks a random public IPTV channel from public playlists (iptv-org / community lists), validates th
e stream (HLS + first segment fetch, prefers H.264, skips DRM/HEVC-only) before playing, with a "换台

/ next" button and a channel picker (countries + search).
- **Settings panel** (gear): edit each sit
e's URL, choose mobile/desktop UA, drag to reorder, delete, and add from a built-in catalog of mains

tream video sites. Saved to `localStorage`.
- **Per-tab keep-alive**: switching tabs does not reload

the page; last URL / scroll / playback position is remembered.
- **Global volume + mute memory**: o

ne slider/mute for all tabs; starts **muted at 1/3 volume**; your changes are remembered.
- **Purpos
ely no cookies from Chrome**: each site runs in an isolated session; log in once inside the panel.

## Install
### 1) From GitHub (recommended)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use `--profile web` instead if you run `dsh web` (the Web profile). The shorter `github:MathewWuZJ/d
sh-tv` also works on setups whose pnpm accepts GitHub shorthands.
Installation enables the bundle automatically. Fully quit and relaunch DeepSeek Harness, and the `DS
H-TV` button appears in the chat header (top-right). If it does not, open **Plugins → Installed** an
d check that `dsh-tv` is enabled.
### 2) As a plugin-market index entry
DSH has no central third-party marketplace; third parties publish packages and **custom plugin index
es**. This repo ships `market-index.json` (format 1). Switch on the experimental **Custom plugin ind
exes** bundle (Plugins → Experimental plugins), then open **Discover → Manage index sources…** and a
s** bundle (Plugins → Experimental plugins), then open **Discover → Manage index sources…** and add:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
then install from the Discover tab.
## Compatibility & avoiding "plugin disappeared after DSH upgrade"
DSH enforces each plugin's `engines.dsh` range; a bundle that does not match is **silently skipped**
(no entry, cannot open). This package declares:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The range intentionally allows every `0.2.x`. If DSH later moves to `0.3.x` (or a new major), a ne

w release of this plugin must widen the range.
- When a version is skipped you can temporarily allow

it per-version: `dsh plugin allow-version` (plugin manager) — exact-version exemption only.
- Best
practice for authors: keep `engines.dsh` a **range** (not an exact prerelease), test against the new
est DSH, and publish updated releases on major bumps.
## Usage

- Open the panel from the `DSH-TV` button in the chat header (top-right).
- Switch sites via favicon

tabs. The first visit shows a spinner; the page is revealed only after it loads.
- Global TV: opens

a random validated channel; **地图** opens the map/channel picker, **换台** picks another.
- Gear: edit

sites; **地图** (player) can fall back to the built-in picker when the external map is unreachable.
-
Volume: click the speaker to mute; hover/click to adjust; settings persist.
## FAQ / Q&A;

**Q: After upgrading DSH, the DSH-TV entry disappeared and I can't open it.**
A: DSH skipped the bun
dle because its `engines.dsh` is incompatible with the new runtime. Update to a plugin release that
matches, or grant an exact-version exemption with `dsh plugin allow-version`. See "Compatibility" ab
hes, or grant an exact-version exemption with `dsh plugin allow-version`. See "Compatibility" above.

**Q: A site shows a blank page or stays on the spinner.**
A: Many sites refuse to be embedded or are
region/network restricted. The panel reports a load failure instead of hiding it; try the site's de
sktop/mobile mode in Settings, or open it in your system browser.

**Q: Can it use my Chrome cookies / logins?**
A: No. The embedded browser is an isolated session and
is not allowed to read Chrome's cookie store. Log in once inside the panel; some login state can be
remembered locally on a best-effort basis (non-HttpOnly cookies + localStorage).

**Q: Where does Global TV come from?**
A: Public IPTV playlists (mostly iptv-org and community lists
). Streams are community-maintained; some are offline or geo-blocked. The player validates a channel
before returning it and auto-switches on failure. No streams are hosted by this project.

**Q: Is there an official plugin marketplace?**
A: Not for third-party plugins. For dsh-tv the avail
able install paths are exactly the two above: a GitHub install with `dsh plugin add`, or adding our
`market-index.json` in Discover. **No npm package is published** — the npm name `dsh-tv` belongs to
an unrelated package, so do not run `dsh plugin add dsh-tv`. Official bundles are shipped by DSH its
nrelated package, so do not run `dsh plugin add dsh-tv`. Official bundles are shipped by DSH itself.

**Q: Is my data sent anywhere?**
A: The plugin only loads the sites you open and the global TV playl
ists. Session snapshots (for best-effort login resume) are written under `~/.dsh/social-session/`; t
he TV playlist is cached there too. Nothing is sent to the author.
